title: Conditional Access preview extends controls to agent user accounts (risk, compliance, CSA)
summary: Microsoft Entra What's new lists a public preview that widens Conditional Access for AI agents that have a user account. Admins can include or exclude individual agents or group them with custom security attributes, apply agent-risk based controls, require compliant devices (including Windows 365 for Agents), and use device platform, filter-for-devices and compliant-network conditions for agents that run on endpoints.
why: Agent identities that act as users inherit the blast radius of those users. Tenant-wide user CA alone will not express agent risk or agent-specific device requirements; this preview is the control plane for that gap as Agent 365 and Copilot agents spread.
